about_the_game:
Hi, "Classic Start of International Students" is a story about freshmen studying abroad in Australia.

Here, you are a newcomer to this country full of kangaroos and koalas, starting the most important period of your life.

Here, you meet your childhood playmates again, meet new friends, hang out together, and inadvertently shoulder a mysterious mission....

What is the meaning of studying abroad? Enjoy a carefree college life? Experience a one-way ticket without a second time, leave traces of youth in the passage of time, or find the direction of life and find your own understanding of life in this completely new experience.

Many stories will happen here, and you will also gain a lot of feelings.

Are you ready? Experience this classic start of international students together.

-Game Introduction-

This is a real-person interactive POV (point of view) first-person character perspective FMV (full motion video) film and television interactive game. You can choose the plot branch you want to follow in the game, and eventually lead to your own plot life. In this process, you can affect different endings and change your relationship with everyone.

-Game Features-

The "time gem" you accidentally obtained can help you, and you can return to any node you once "regretted" and restart your game branch.

I can't wait, there are still many things to say to you in the game... and, unknown, waiting for you to explore... Easter eggs.
